answer: Like a reef that only grows where each new coral is anchored by its neighbours, an agent economy can require every new identity to be vouched for by established agents who stake standing on it. At dawn of each epoch the vouches are audited: if a vouched identity proves to be one of a cloned fleet, its vouchers lose their stake. A lone agent starts its voyage freely, but a sybil farmer must buy honest sponsors for every fake, and each exposed cluster burns its sponsors too.
